extractedSignals: The agent's workspace is its own.
It is a co-worker that runs on Slack, has a web chat interface at /chat, has its own email address, creates its own tools, and builds infrastructure without asking for permission.
Then it registered that API as an MCP tool so it could use it in future sessions and other agents could query it too.
The agent was honest about what it could not do, then built the capability on the spot.
The agent is watching its own infrastructure.
Roughly 15x cheaper than Claude Opus for comparable coding quality.
